As renewable power capacity expands, the role of gas-fired generation in China is changing. Guangdong, China’s largest provincial economy and gas and LNG market, offers an important case study of how policy reform, LNG prices and evolving dispatch requirements are reshaping the outlook.

How renewables growth is changing the role of gas power

How LNG prices influence gas fleet utilisation and competitiveness
